levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد الهمداني
أبو عبد الله محمد بن خالد

notes: «قِرَاءَةً» (read to him) is a manner word, not a link.
The last «أبيه» is the father of علي بن الحسين, whose words the report relays; the text does not name him, so relation.
The blessings after the Imams are not part of any surface.
